_nota: Language DIAGNOSIS set: the same 25 questions of the main and validation sets, in English and with the same expectations verified in the PDFs. It separates the language failure from the retrieval failure: if it hits a lot in English and little in Spanish, the bottleneck is the translation. It is not used to tune the search. The first 16 correspond to the main set and the next 9 to the validation set, in the same order.
